name: Nebraska Legislative Bill 525 — Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act
description: Nebraska statute requiring providers of human-like conversational AI and companion chatbot services to conspicuously disclose that the user is interacting with an AI rather than a human, maintain mental health crisis detection and referral protocols, and refrain from representing the chatbot as a licensed mental or behavioral health professional.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of Nebraska (nebraska.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of Nebraska (nebraska.gov).
